title: Review: final pass post-comment-fixes
notes: Final pass: 7 real findings. Confidence: 92% no missed bugs — residual uncertainty is around edge cases in outbox_tick error paths (store-lock poison path silently aborts the tick with no retry scheduled) and whether the blob upload handler correctly rejects a zero-byte body (axum to_bytes with limit+1 allows it through; the store then writes a zero-byte file). Neither rose to filing level on this pass. No stale 'Contact' strings found. No 'Contact/' method name strings found. Clippy and cargo check both clean. Bikeshedding assessment: findings 3 and 6 are borderline (P4 efficiency/test style); I am confident they have engineering basis (OnceLock pattern inconsistency and test-oracle duplication violating the project's test integrity rules) and are not bikeshedding.
